description: Polymarket Odds: Current odds for a specific Polymarket market — pass the slug you already have, or the numeric market id, or a keyword to search with. Returns every outcome with its implied probability, plus 24h volume, liquidity, end date and the CLOB token ids. Use this once you know which market you mean; use x402-poly-markets or x402-polymarket-scan to find one in the first place.
name: x402-polymarket-odds
